CONTRACT CHALLENGE — Design the anonymized data lake — best practices from every mission, shareable across clients

Acceptance criteria: Anonymized by design: industry, category, problem type — NOT specific company; Full codification control: FastOps names problems and solutions; Flywheel: more missions → richer lake → smarter agents → better missions; /jailbreak + /horsepower run on design BEFORE building

Silhouette: PRD Block 7. Depends on Block 6 (client pipeline) producing data to anonymize. The data IS the product — every solved problem enriches the lake for future agents. Unlocks sharing because anonymized data doesn't expose clients.

This contract requires external challenge. Requesting perspective.
